title: Methodology Card Schema
description: Canonical schema for documenting how an open-data-explainers module computes derived metrics: inputs, transforms, parameters, limits, and explicit disclaimers.

description.description: Plain-language summary of what this explainer computes

version.description: Semantic version of this Methodology Card (e.g., '1.0.0')

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this card was last updated

name.description: Human-readable name of the source dataset

publisher.description: Publisher or agency that maintains the source

sourceUrl.description: URL where the source can be found

retrievalDate.description: Date when this specific snapshot of the data was retrieved (YYYY-MM-DD)

datasetVersion.description: Version identifier or release number of the dataset (e.g., '2024 Q1', 'v3.2.1')

license.description: SPDX identifier or name of the source license (e.g., 'CC0-1.0', 'OGL-3.0', 'ODbL-1.0')

licenseUrl.description: URL to the full license text

notes.description: Optional notes on data quality, caveats, or processing at retrieval

transforms.description: Documented transformations and derivations applied to the input data

description.description: Plain-language description of what this transform does and why

codeLocation.description: Path(s) to committed source code implementing this transform (e.g., 'src/derive.ts#L42-L120')

inputFields.description: Names of input fields/columns used by this transform

outputFields.description: Names of output fields/columns produced by this transform

normalisation.description: If applicable, how data is normalized (e.g., 'per-capita', 'rate-per-100k', 'percentage')

parameters.description: Configurable thresholds, weights, and parameters used in derivation

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what this parameter controls

rationale.description: Why this value was chosen; evidence or justification

walkDistanceThreshold.description: Maximum walking distance to consider transit accessible
walkDistanceThreshold.rationale: Aligns with US transit-planning convention (approximately 1/2 mile)

minimumCellCount.description: Minimum number of records in a geographic/temporal bin before publishing
minimumCellCount.rationale: PII/de-identification standard to prevent identification of individuals

vintage.description: Data currency and temporal scope of this explainer

dataStartDate.description: Earliest date included in the computed metrics (YYYY-MM-DD)

dataEndDate.description: Most recent date included in the computed metrics (YYYY-MM-DD)

currency.description: Plain-language currency statement (e.g., 'updated quarterly', 'static as of 2024-06-30')

refreshCadence.description: How often this explainer is intended to be re-run (e.g., 'annual', 'quarterly', 'never')

staleAfterDays.description: Number of days after dataEndDate before flagging as stale

outdatedAfterDays.description: Number of days after dataEndDate before flagging as outdated

knownLimits.description: Documented limitations, assumptions, and data quality caveats

impact.description: How this limitation affects the reliability or applicability of the results

mitigation.description: Any steps taken to mitigate this limitation

doesNotClaim.description: Explicit disclaimers: things this explainer deliberately does NOT claim

causation.description: Why no causal claims are made (e.g., 'These are observational data; we show correlation, not causation')

ranking.description: Why places/entities are not ranked as 'best/worst' (e.g., 'This is not a ranking; differences may be due to data quality or methodology')

prediction.description: Why no future predictions are made (e.g., 'This explainer shows historical patterns only, not forecasts')

advice.description: Explicit statement that this is not actionable advice

other.description: Other specific claims not made by this explainer

reproducibility.description: Information on how to reproduce this explainer's results

codeRepository.description: Git repository URL containing the derivation code

codeCommit.description: Git commit hash of the version that produced these results

testHarness.description: Path to golden-fixture tests that verify reproducibility (e.g., 'test/fixtures/golden.test.ts')

buildInstructions.description: Command to reproduce (e.g., 'pnpm build && pnpm test')
